## Overview

The Media Viewer includes a vertical toolbar on the left edge of the canvas (to the left of the pixel ruler). Tools are shown as square icon buttons; one tool is selected at a time.

## Select Tool

The pointer (mouse) icon is the **Select** tool. It is selected by default.

When Select is active, an options bar appears above the horizontal ruler. Use **Selection filter** to limit picking to a specific enabled feature, or leave it on **All enabled features** to consider every key currently enabled in the feature table.

Canvas selection behavior is not wired yet; the filter only stores your preference for a future release.
